name: infra
description: Provision nSelf infrastructure with Terraform: plan, apply and destroy modules for aws, gcp, azure, hetzner, do and linode.
author: nself

actions.plan: Show the Terraform plan for a provider without changing anything

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port, no HTTP server, and no database tables. `nself plugin install infra` must place the built nself-infra binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/nself-infra, where internal/plugin/router.go's ProxyCommand execs it for `nself infra <args>` with stdio inherited. Extracted from cli/cmd/commands/infra.go and cli/internal/infra/ under CLI-R11. Requires terraform on PATH at run time; the plugin does not bundle it.
